title: Implement Union-Find (Disjoint Set Union) in Go
description: Greenfield Go task: implement DSU (Disjoint Set Union) with path-compressed Find, union-by-rank Union, Connected, and Components methods.

required_artifacts: parent slice initialized to identity, rank to zeros
Find uses path compression (recursive or iterative)
Union by rank: higher-rank root becomes parent, components decremented on merge
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
